plain_text:
Edmond O’Brien appears in 79 recordings across 6 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1939 to 1952. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Edmond O’Brien most often in Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Lux Radio Theatre, Screen Directors Playhouse, Escape, Fu Manchu, and NBC University Theater.

Characters credited here include Johnny Dollar and Inspector Rymer.
